title: Segmented control
summary: A compact single choice between two to five views, such as Day, Week and Month. It is always controlled and always has one option selected.

demos.title: Default
demos.note: One raised thumb slides to the chosen option. Left and right arrow keys move it.

demos.title: Small
demos.note: For card headers and chart toolbars.

demos.title: With icons
demos.note: A label can be any node. Keep the words: an icon alone is a guess.
